objective: Compare optimized fMLX and fully accelerated Splash on the same Apple silicon host with identical model inputs and generation semantics.

sampling.stopPolicy: same explicit token IDs; a cell is invalid if any engine stops before requested output length

measurement.engineIsolation: Only one engine may own or submit GPU work at a time.
measurement.ttftBoundary: Immediately before request submission through receipt of the first generated token, including admission and prefill.
measurement.decodeBoundary: Receipt of the first generated token through completion of the requested output; throughput excludes the first token.
measurement.endToEndBoundary: Immediately before request submission through terminal completion after the requested output.
measurement.fanoutBoundary: Immediately before submitting all four requests through completion of the last request.
measurement.memoryBoundary: Peak process resident bytes and peak/cached MLX bytes from immediately before request submission through terminal completion.
measurement.steadyMemoryPoint: Process resident bytes after warmup and before the measured request, with weights resident.

noisePolicy.action: Mark the cell inconclusive and repeat the complete cell after cooling; retain the rejected samples.

workloads.prefixPattern: 7936-token saved conversation prefix plus a 256-token appended turn
four identical rendered prompts submitted together
